text:
incident-bot: Paging: p99 tail latency spike detected on streaming inference path (streaming-worker pool). Alert: p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Customers affected: us-west-2 streaming tier. Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/8943 :rotating_light:
jamie_oncall: I'm on pager. joining now.
miguel_sre: seeing the same, p50 fine, p95 ~300ms, p99 ~1300ms. Do we have a correlated scheduler metric?
emma_runtime: quick summary: continuous batching path has higher pack latency and packing rate jumped. KV eviction count spiked on shard 12. Might be mixed-seqlen packing creating oversized batches.
ozzy_ml: could be long-seq requests creating pack amplification. Any recent model/quant changes?
nick_infra: no infra deploys in last hour, but runtime config push at 2759999000 increased default max_batch_bytes for streamers.
jamie_oncall: timeline: spike started ~2767799940, steady for ~6m. Customer complaints: 3 support tickets about slow responses (chat timeouts).
emma_runtime: logs (shard12): ```pack_attempt=1 pack_size_tokens=20480 batch_count=128 pack_duration_ms=420 avg_token_ms=3.5 kv_evictions=47```
miguel_sre: those are huge batches for streaming. p99 correlates with pack_duration_ms>400.
ozzy_ml: hypothesis: scheduler fairness favored throughput -> greedy packing of hetero seqs -> long tails. Mitigation options: 1) cap max batch size; 2) enforce seq-length bucketing; 3) preempt long sequences for streaming.
jamie_oncall: agree. Which is fastest rollback?
nick_infra: fastest is lowering max_batch_tokens on runtime shard group. I can push a config change to reduce max_batch_tokens from 25000 -> 8000 for streaming pool.
emma_runtime: that should drop pack_size and reduce tail. Also enable shorter-seq priority for streaming lanes.
miguel_sre: any customer impact from lowering max batch? throughput drop but latency improves. We should communicate to support.
ozzy_ml: also suggest enabling aggressive prefix KV caching for repeated prefixes to reduce token generation cost. But that's medium risk.
jamie_oncall: let's do quick change now. nick, please patch scheduler. I'll notify support and track metrics.
nick_infra: running: ```redwoodctl runtime set-config --pool streaming-worker --max_batch_tokens 8000 --reason "p99 tail mitigation"```
deploy-bot: Started config change job id=cfg-4821 for streaming-worker.
nick_infra: change applied to container group cg-12. Monitoring...
emma_runtime: after change, pack_duration_ms drops: ```pack_duration_ms=120 avg_pack_size=48 kv_evictions=12```. p99 trending down to ~280ms.
miguel_sre: good. Keep an eye on p95 too. Want to avoid oscillation.
jamie_oncall: emailing support: "We've mitigated a tail-latency spike in streaming inference by tightening batching config; some throughput-sensitive customers may see slight throughput decrease, latency improved"
ozzy_ml: follow-up: we should schedule a runbook item to add seq-length-aware fairness and an automated preemptive shed for sequences > 4096 tokens on streaming lanes.
miguel_sre: +1. Also propose metric alert: pack_duration_ms > 300ms for >3m on any shard -> auto throttle.
nick_infra: I can add a temporary alert rule. Deploying now.```redwoodctl alerts create --name "pack-duration-high" --expr "avg(pack_duration_ms{pool=\"streaming-worker\"}) > 300" --for 3m```
deploy-bot: Alert rule pack-duration-high created id=alert-93.
jamie_oncall: timeline closed? rolling-mitigation looks good, p99 back to normal window. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and hand back to SRE.\emmap_runtime: note: still seeing a few stragglers on shard 7, investigating whether KV hotkey thrash caused manual evictions.
ozzy_ml: if KV hotkeys, we should consider small hotkey pinning / replication to reduce evictions.
miguel_sre: action items: 1) create runbook PR for seq-length fairness (owner: ozzy); 2) tune default max_batch_tokens per pool (owner: nick); 3) add pack-duration alert (done); 4) communicate to customers (owner: jamie).
jamie_oncall: marking incident as mitigated. will update support with notes and close pager if stable. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: p99 fell below threshold for 10m. Auto-close in 30m unless re-opened.
